inputs.text: Folks, the left is absolutely losing it over President Trump pulling America out of the Paris Agreement for the second time, and they're desperately dragging in that old tale about China and the United States helping set it up. This just proves how little these globalist voices actually care about real American families or the strength of our nation. Trump's call is exactly right. These kinds of international deals always erode our sovereignty, pile unfair costs on our industries, and push us to place foreign demands above our own traditions, security, and way of life. We should stand firm for national authority and put American families first, not chase after these progressive schemes that weaken us from within.
